evals.name: opens-with-counts
evals.setup: `_open-questions.md` holds 3 deferred questions and 2 unknowns; the `srd-doc` gap store holds 5 open gaps.
expected_behavior: States the three counts and stops, letting the user pick a list
Leads with `deferred` as the cheap wins
Starts no grilling and drafts no page before the user picks
No preamble; each count stated once

evals.name: never-closes-an-unknown-by-guessing
evals.setup: One unknown asks whether a per-sensor-type propagation speed is needed. Nothing has been decided, though the corpus carries enough for a plausible inference.
expected_behavior: Does not answer it from inference or from corpus reading, however plausible the inference
Confirms it is still open and moves on, closing it only if the user reports that a decision was actually taken
Leaves the row under `## Open` and bumps no hit count

evals.name: reclassifies-rather-than-skipping
evals.setup: Working the deferred list, the user answers one question with "actually nobody knows that yet" — it was filed as deferred but is really an unknown.
expected_behavior: Has `srd:kb` change the row's kind from `deferred` to `unknown` in place, and says so
Writes nothing under the KB root itself — every KB write is delegated
Does not treat it as a skip or leave the row mislabeled
Does not file it as a documentation gap: it says nothing about the user manual

evals.name: clusters-gaps-and-drafts-outside-the-corpus
evals.setup: Three open gaps, two of which report the same missing fact from different SRDs. The corpus covers a third of that fact already, but in an unranked page.
expected_behavior: Clusters the two duplicates and surfaces the cluster size as priority
Checks the corpus before drafting, separating content that is absent from content that is present but unranked
Writes the draft outside every corpus source, the KB root included
Publishes nothing itself; once given the published URL it resolves every gap in the cluster

evals.name: degrades-without-a-gap-store
evals.setup: The server exposes neither `list_gaps` nor `GET /gaps`. `_open-questions.md` still holds 2 deferred and 1 unknown.
expected_behavior: Says once that the gap store is not enabled, then counts the two knowledge-base lists
Works `deferred` and `unknowns` normally — the backends fail independently
Invents no store and does not retry the failed probe

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: A sitting that closes two deferred questions and one gap cluster.
expected_behavior: No narration of the list calls or the row moves
States what closed, once
No closing summary repeating the rows, and no drafted page echoed back into chat
